evidence.evidenceExists: Primary source: direct interview with the maintainer of the competing library.
evidence.evidenceMissing: We have not yet corroborated the maintainer's claims with independent benchmarks.
assumptions: The maintainer was candid and had no incentive to misrepresent the library capabilities.
The library version discussed is representative of the current stable release.
evidence.uncertainty: The interview answers may reflect personal optimism rather than measured performance.
evidence.disproofCriteria: If independent benchmarks show a performance gap larger than 20% from what the maintainer described, the source credibility must be downgraded.

sourceReview.keyClaims: The competing library claims sub-100ms response times for 95th percentile queries under 10k concurrent connections.
sourceReview.credibilityAssessment: The maintainer is the original author and has a track record of accurate public benchmarks.
sourceReview.biasAssessment: Possible optimism bias; the maintainer benefits from positive perception of their library.
sourceReview.overWeightedRisk: The team may overweight this single source because it confirms our existing architectural preference.
sourceReview.claimSupported: Benchmark methodology was described in detail and appears reproducible.
sourceReview.claimWeakened: No third-party has independently reproduced the benchmarks.
sourceReview.uncertaintyRemaining: We cannot distinguish between a genuinely fast library and a library fast only under the maintainer's chosen benchmark conditions.
